# mailtrap_project (Data Source)

Reads a Mailtrap project by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a project by name...
data "mailtrap_project" "by_name" {
  name = "My Project"
}

# ...or by ID.
data "mailtrap_project" "by_id" {
  id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the project. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Name of the project. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `share_links` (Attributes) Public share URLs for the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share_links))

<a id="nestedatt--share_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share_links`

Read-Only:

- `admin` (String)
- `viewer` (String)
